articles.title: Nvidia Earnings Preview: 6 key factors investors will watch
articles.description: Nvidia is set to report its fiscal third-quarter 2027 results on November 17, with investors looking for evidence that the artificial intelligence boom continues to drive growth despite mounting market uncertainty and a leadership shake-up. Wall Street expects revenue of approximately $108.9 billion, up around 91% year-on-year, while adjusted earnings are forecast at $2.47 per share. (Sources: Yahoo Finance, FXStreet) ​Nvidia faces $109 billion earnings test
